messages:
tess: saw a big regression in eviction fairness during the 09:00 perf sweep. small tenants got squeezed when a handful of prefixes spiked.

morgan: confirmed. heatmap had 3 prefixes consuming ~68% of resident blocks for ~30s.

tess: proposal: 'namespace slimming' 14 at eviction time we collapse low-entropy suffix variants into a single accounting bucket so they don't fragment residency. helps fairshare.

alex: curious about correctness. collapsing keys could let the shape bucket serve stale/misattributed entries if we later probe it for reads.

tess: agree. plan is conservative: phase A = accounting-only (shape buckets affect eviction weights only). phase B = optional read-probe after validation with verification metadata.

sanjay: sketch lookup: 1) exact key probe 2) if miss and shape enabled, probe shape-bucket and check entry.meta.shape_id == active_shape. extra hop on miss.

li: that's an extra L1 probe on misses. prefer accounting-only default. enable read-probe only for candidates with high miss-to-hit ratios.

morgan: also need billing and isolation guarantees. if a shape contains multiple tenants we must keep per-tenant residency attribution counters (approx ok).

tess: controller will push shape -> {shape_id, mode, ttl, excluded_prefixes}. runtime keeps shape metadata and per-tenant counters (atomic add/dec).

alex: contention on counters could be a hotspot. consider sharded approximate counters (bloom-ish) to bound locks.

sanjay: ops: pinned prefixes must be excluded. pin API sets anti-slim bit. controller never includes pinned keyspaces in candidate shapes.

infra-bot: canary-config: runtime.enable_namespace_slimming=false -> rollout group runtime-canary-evict-3

li: metrics to add: eviction_share_by_shape, shape_probe_latency_p95, shape_attribution_collision_rate, soft_pin_exclusions_count. dashboard before phase B.

morgan: propose a nightly job to score prefix candidates (churn, suffix-entropy, read-locality). controller outputs a ranked list and suggested mode.

tess: i'll draft an RFC follow-up with: 1) accounting-only implementation plan, 2) telemetry + nightly scorer, 3) experiment matrix + canary gating, 4) API spec for controller->runtime shape messages, 5) rollback/runbook.

alex: add a microbench: 1) synthetic burst (one hot prefix) + background small-tenants 2) measure eviction fairness, p99 cold-miss latency, and resident bytes per-tenant.

sanjay: include a correctness test harness that fuzzes suffix churn and verifies no cross-tenant reads after enabling probe.

li: if phase B read-probe shows regressions, we should limit probe to read-only retries (don't promote shape-hit into residency unless exact key verified).

tess: good idea. shape-hit can be used to score eviction but we only promote to exact-key residency after full verification.

morgan: SGTM. @alex @sanjay can you review the RFC draft tomorrow morning?

alex: yes

sanjay: will do

infra-bot: deploy-note: no active deploys. canary flag available.
